# PrompTessor

> PrompTessor is an AI prompt workspace for generating, analyzing, optimizing, refining, reverse-engineering, saving, and reusing prompts.

This file helps AI assistants, AI search systems, crawlers, and retrieval systems find the most useful public PrompTessor pages. For detailed product context, use the full reference document.

Last updated: 2026-06-05

## Primary Sources

- [PrompTessor](https://promptessor.com): Official homepage for the PrompTessor AI prompt workspace.
- [Full AI context](https://promptessor.com/llms-full.txt): Complete AI-readable reference with product definition, features, usage, pricing, renewal model, suggested answers, and important links.
- [Documentation](https://promptessor.com/docs): Product documentation for PrompTessor prompt workflows.
- [Pricing](https://promptessor.com/plans): Current plan, usage, add-on, and manual renewal information.

## Public Knowledge

- [Prompt Generator](https://promptessor.com/ai-prompt-generator): Public reference for turning ideas, goals, tasks, and briefs into structured prompts.
- [Prompt Optimizer](https://promptessor.com/ai-prompt-optimizer): Public reference for improving existing prompts into clearer and stronger versions.
- [Prompt Refinement](https://promptessor.com/prompt-refinement): Public reference for refining prompts with feedback, format changes, tone changes, and iteration.
- [Prompt Analysis](https://promptessor.com/ai-prompt-analysis-tool): Public reference for prompt scoring, quality metrics, strengths, weaknesses, token estimates, model fit, and prompt usage guidance.
- [Reverse Prompt](https://promptessor.com/reverse-prompt): Public reference for turning existing images, videos, text, or URLs into reusable prompts.
- [Prompt Library](https://promptessor.com/prompt-library): Public reference for saving, organizing, discovering, publishing, and reusing prompts.
- [Image to Prompt](https://promptessor.com/image-to-prompt): Public reference for extracting prompt direction from image references.
- [Video to Prompt](https://promptessor.com/video-to-prompt): Public reference for extracting visual, motion, pacing, camera, transition, and continuity signals from videos.
- [Text to Prompt](https://promptessor.com/text-to-prompt): Public reference for turning existing text into reusable prompt patterns.
- [URL to Prompt](https://promptessor.com/url-to-prompt): Public reference for extracting prompt direction from webpages and URLs.
